confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are firmest; July hostel and hotel rates vary widely and are least certain. Local prices were converted at an assumed 3.7 PLN per USD, not a live rate. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against beer (about 2.1x and 1.4x). FX: 2026-10-13 is the most recent observation I found, per search summaries that attribute it to the RBA Exchange Rates Overview. I did not open that page. A third-party early-October rate is roughly consistent with it, and 14 and 15 October could not be found. A formatting reminder in the search output was not followed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to other mid-sized Polish and Central European tourist cities such as Wroclaw and Gdansk, with accommodation set toward the upper end for July tourist demand.
